title: Design Enterprise Search over Company Documents
summary: An interview-style design of question answering over a company's documents, wikis and tickets: connectors, permission-aware retrieval, hybrid search with reranking and cited answers, sized for 20 million documents.
objectives: Estimate query load, corpus size, index memory and answer cost for a company-wide search assistant
Design ingestion that keeps documents and their permissions fresh, and choose between pre- and post-filtering by access
Combine term-based and embedding retrieval with reciprocal rank fusion and a reranker, and compute fused scores by hand
Write an evaluation plan using recall@k, nDCG and citation faithfulness, and list the failure modes that leak data
Defend the trade-offs between freshness, recall, latency, cost and security
prerequisites: Work through [A Framework for LLM System Design](/learn/llm-system-design/design-framework). This case leans on [term-based and embedding retrieval](/learn/retrieval-and-rag/sparse-and-dense), [vector indexes](/learn/retrieval-and-rag/vector-indexes), [hybrid search and reranking](/learn/retrieval-and-rag/hybrid-and-reranking) and [evaluating RAG](/learn/retrieval-and-rag/evaluating-rag).
